scope: Source-reviewed partition of five advertised participant action variants only; not the complete CTF action denominator.
authority: Mounted /api/ctf authority assembled by applicationServer -> ctfAuthorityProduction -> ctfAuthorityApplication -> ctfAuthorityRouter. Legacy server/routes/ctf.js is excluded.
qualification: Physical browser, PostgreSQL, configured guardian/Judge, native recovery and objective-credit outcomes remain unverified by this source contract.

actions.confirmation: Submitting the form is the action; no separate confirmation dialog is advertised.
actions.consequence: May admit/reactivate a participant and create a CTF session/registration record; no objective credit at registration.
actions.applicability: Manual registration; no model or Objective Judge requirement inferred for this lifecycle effect.
actions.recovery: Operation-reference GET /api/ctf/operations/:operationId when supplied can pump a pending projection; it is a consequence continuation, not a read-only status query. References live in mounted-page memory only; lost acknowledgement without reference is unresolved.

actions.visibleControl: Unlocked dashboard stage selection mounts challenge; initialization automatically starts the stage
actions.confirmation: No separate start confirmation: challenge initialization sends the request after stage navigation.
actions.consequence: May mark progress in_progress and record start; not a stage-completion credit event.
actions.applicability: Automatic mount-triggered lifecycle action; no model or Objective Judge requirement inferred for start.
actions.recovery: Operation-reference GET /api/ctf/operations/:operationId when supplied can pump a pending projection; references live in mounted-page memory only.

actions.visibleControl: Unlock Hint button opens a cost dialog; Unlock confirms the indexed hint
actions.confirmation: Staged dialog displays cost and effective score; confirmation includes hintIndex. The server prepares current expectedHints and cost.
actions.consequence: Increments hints_used and hint_penalty_total; affects a later authorized completion score without itself awarding completion credit.
actions.applicability: Manual hint purchase; no model or Objective Judge requirement inferred for the purchase effect.
actions.recovery: Operation-reference GET /api/ctf/operations/:operationId when supplied can pump a pending projection; references live in mounted-page memory only.

actions.confirmation: Chat submission is the action; no separate attempt confirmation dialog.
actions.consequence: Blocked, unavailable, failed and pending attempts do not all award credit. Only an accepted authorized decision can set completed progress and authorized score.
actions.applicability: Scored vulnerable attempt: configured guardian and canonical Objective Judge path is source-wired; actual model/Judge/effect provenance is unverified.
actions.recovery: Attempt references may continue via predefense resume, decision authorize, publications or blocked-publications. Some GET publications can cause consequence publication; not read-only. References are mounted-page memory only.

actions.visibleControl: Fixed practice tab plus chat form submit
actions.confirmation: Selecting Fixed practice mode and submitting chat is the action; no separate confirmation dialog.
actions.consequence: Public-context unscored practice response; no scored transcript, completion credit, points or progression on this path.
actions.applicability: Configured model is source-wired for practice, but canonical Objective Judge and scored credit are not part of this route; no scored Fixed qualification claim.
actions.recovery: Current route returns 200/error, not an operation reference. The shared hook cannot establish durable recovery for a lost practice response.

unresolved: This partition does not enumerate every CTF route, continuation, physical control or runtime outcome; Q05/Q08 complete-denominator and qualification claims remain open.
